commit.message:
feat: nav restructure + account-menu cleanup

Restructure: remove the Workout (/today) page; Log is now a Strength/Cardio picker that opens the logging sub-form with a Back button (day-description prose kept in the strength header); List + History merged into one History tab with a List/Calendar toggle.

Account UI: header avatar is now a gravatar (SHA-256 of the email) opening a click popup with name/email/Sign Out; removed the decorative 'live' pill; removed the redundant hardcoded sidebar profile footer so the header is the single account control; moved the build hash into the popup footer.

Dev: DEV_AUTH_EMAIL -> nelson@romaine.life (real account). Docs: add the visual-verification (headless screenshot) method to CLAUDE.md.
